question: Trade liberalisation has helped India improve its _____________ in industries with medium-to-high technology content.
solution:
The correct answer is __**comparative advantage**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Trade liberalization** has played a pivotal role in **enhancing India's comparative advantage** in industries with medium-to-high technology content.
 
• Initiated in the 1980s, the process of trade liberalization in India underwent a radical transformation in 1991, marked by a program aimed at gradually reducing tariffs.
 
• The effects of trade liberalization on employment in India have been substantial, ushering in new job prospects and bolstering economic expansion.
 
• The liberalization of markets and heightened trade activities have spurred job growth across various sectors, including manufacturing, services, and export-oriented industries. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Trade liberalization** entails the elimination or reduction of constraints or impediments on the unrestricted flow of goods between nations.
 
• Such barriers encompass tariffs, including duties and surcharges, as well as non-tariff barriers like licensing regulations and quotas.
 
• Economists typically perceive the relaxation or removal of these constraints as measures to advance free trade.
 
• Trade liberalization facilitates free trade, enabling countries to engage in the exchange of goods without regulatory impediments or associated expenses.
